title: Counit images of the two integral comparison composites
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $A_{E,m}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^m$ for $m\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Z\xrightarrow h W\xrightarrow k V$ be isomorphisms of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with small pro-etale sites, completed sheaves $R_T=\lim_m(A_{E,m})_T$ and their module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For $N\in D^b_c(V,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], choose the flat-term K-flat resolution $q:P\to N$ used for completed pullback [def-pc-kflat-complex, lem-pc-kflat-resolution, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Put $P_m=P\otimes_{R_V}(A_{E,m})_V$. For $g=k,kh$ put $C_{g,m}=\operatorname{Res}_m g_m^*P_m$ with actual quotient transitions; let $\theta_g^\Delta:\Delta g^{-1}P\to C_{g,\bullet}$ be the strict map with components $x\mapsto\bar x\otimes1$ [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison]. Here $g^{-1}$ has its module action transported through the specified completed coefficient isomorphism, and $\Delta$ is the termwise constant-tower functor [def-weil-inverse-system]. Set $M=Lk^*N=R\lim C_{k,\bullet}$, $D_\bullet=h^*C_{k,\bullet}$, and $X=h^{-1}k^{-1}N$.
Let $d_P:h^{-1}k^{-1}P\xrightarrow\sim(kh)^{-1}P$ and $d_N$ be the canonical inverse-image compositors [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $c_\bullet:C_{kh,\bullet}\xrightarrow\sim D_\bullet$ have components the canonical finite module pullback compositors $(kh)^*P_m\xrightarrow\sim h^*k^*P_m$ [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-derived-pullback-composition]. Let $u_{h,C_k}:h^{-1}C_{k,\bullet}\to D_\bullet$ have components $x\mapsto x\otimes1$ [def-trf-integral-tower-inverse-image-unit]. Let $\eta:Lh^*M\xrightarrow\sim R\lim D_\bullet$ and $c^E:L(kh)^*N\xrightarrow\sim Lh^*M$ be exactly the normalized comparisons of [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization], so $\eta c^E=R\lim(c_\bullet)$. Use the specified $\kappa$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and its normalized Roos identification with total derived limit. For each strict tower $T$, $\epsilon_T:\Delta R\lim T\to T$ is the whole-tower counit computed on a K-injective tower resolution by the ordinary limit cone [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-strict-tower-homotopy-limit]. Define
$$a=\eta\circ c^E\circ\kappa^{kh}_N\circ d_N,\qquad b=\eta\circ\kappa^h_M\circ h^{-1}(\kappa^k_N),\qquad Q=h^{-1}k^{-1}(q).$$
Then the following two identities hold in $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R_Z)))$, both with source $\Delta X$ and target $D_\bullet$:
$$\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(a)=c_\bullet\circ\theta_{kh}^\Delta\circ\Delta(d_P)\circ\Delta[Q]^{-1},$$
$$\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(b)=u_{h,C_k}\circ h^{-1}(\theta_k^\Delta)\circ\Delta[Q]^{-1}.$$
The canonical commutation of exact termwise $h^{-1}$ with $\Delta$ is implicit. These are formulas for entire strict tower morphisms, retaining the common resolution denominator; they assert neither equality of $a,b$ nor faithfulness of separate derived evaluations.

source.place: Step 1, Global powers: compatibility with composition before rationalization; extracted whole-tower counit-image calculation from the returned item Steps 3–4. Derived-limit normalization: Stacks Tag 0941, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok. This composition calculation is agent-written, not a verbatim assertion of that tag.

proof.text: Put $H=h^{-1}$, $G=k^{-1}$ and $J=(kh)^{-1}$, with the completed coefficient actions in the statement. The inverse-image module functors are exact by [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison], so $[Q]=[HG(q)]$ and $[J(q)]$ are invertible. The compositors $d_P,d_N$ are linear for the transported completed actions: [lem-trf-constant-coefficient-composition] gives $c_{kh}=c_h\circ h^{-1}(c_k)\circ\alpha_{h,k}$ for every constant ring $A_{E,m}$, and projecting to every quotient in the structure-map formula $\pi_m\circ c_{\mathcal O_E}=c^g_{A_{E,m}}\circ g^{-1}(\pi_m)$ of [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] gives the same identity for the completed coefficient isomorphisms; hence their termwise maps are morphisms of complexes of $R_Z$-modules and descend to the derived category. Naturality of the specified inverse-image compositor, applied to the chain map $q:P\to N$, gives $[J(q)]\circ[d_P]=[d_N]\circ[Q]$. Multiplying this equation by the indicated inverses yields $[J(q)]^{-1}\circ[d_N]=[d_P]\circ[Q]^{-1}$. This fixes the denominator needed for the first formula before taking any tower counit.

source.place: Step 1, Global powers, integral compatibility with composition; agent whole-tower counit calculation, split Step 1. Normalization background: Stacks Tag 0941, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; derived adjunction: Tag 0FND, derived.tex, lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general.

proof.text: Apply [lem-trf-integral-comparison-counit-characterization] to $g=kh$ and to $g=k$, each time with the same chosen resolution $q:P\to N$ and its actual quotient tower. Its hypotheses hold since $k$ and $kh$ are scheme isomorphisms, $N\in D^b_c(V,\mathcal O_E)$, and the coefficient actions and Roos identifications are precisely the specified ones. This gives the whole-tower equations $\epsilon_{C_{kh}}\circ\Delta(\kappa^{kh}_N)=\theta_{kh}^\Delta\circ\Delta[J(q)]^{-1}$ and $\epsilon_{C_k}\circ\Delta(\kappa^k_N)=\theta_k^\Delta\circ\Delta[G(q)]^{-1}$. These are equations in the derived categories of strict completed-module towers.

source.place: Step 1, Global powers, integral compatibility with composition; agent whole-tower counit calculation, split Step 2. Normalization background: Stacks Tag 0941, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; derived adjunction: Tag 0FND, derived.tex, lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general.

proof.text:
Naturality in the tower variable of the counit in [lem-trf-integral-comparison-counit-characterization], at the whole-tower morphism $c_\bullet:C_{kh,\bullet}\to D_\bullet$, says $\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(R\lim(c_\bullet))=c_\bullet\circ\epsilon_{C_{kh}}$. The normalization in [lem-trf-integral-pullback-comparison-realization] gives $\eta\circ c^E=R\lim(c_\bullet)$ with exactly this $c_\bullet$. Therefore functoriality of $\Delta$, the first equation of Step 2 and Step 1 give
$$\begin{aligned}\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(a)&=c_\bullet\circ\epsilon_{C_{kh}}\circ\Delta(\kappa^{kh}_N)\circ\Delta(d_N)\\&=c_\bullet\circ\theta_{kh}^\Delta\circ\Delta[J(q)]^{-1}\circ\Delta(d_N)\\&=c_\bullet\circ\theta_{kh}^\Delta\circ\Delta(d_P)\circ\Delta[Q]^{-1}.\end{aligned}$$
This proves the first asserted identity.

source.place: Step 1, Global powers, integral compatibility with composition; agent whole-tower counit calculation, split Step 3. Normalization background: Stacks Tag 0941, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; derived adjunction: Tag 0FND, derived.tex, lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general.

proof.text:
Apply [lem-trf-integral-pullback-resolution-matching] to these $h,k,N$ and their chosen quotient tower $C_{k,\bullet}$. Its $M$, tower $h^*C_{k,\bullet}$, termwise tensor unit and normalized $\eta_{h,k,N}$ are respectively our $M,D_\bullet,u_{h,C_k},\eta$; no independently chosen comparison is substituted. It gives
$$\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(\eta\circ\kappa^h_M)=u_{h,C_k}\circ H(\epsilon_{C_k}).$$
The lemma applies to scheme isomorphisms on the same small pro-etale sites and to the same bounded constructible complete input $N$; it places the equality in the entire derived tower category with source $\Delta H M$.

source.place: Step 1, Global powers, integral compatibility with composition; agent whole-tower counit calculation, split Step 4. Normalization background: Stacks Tag 0941, sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok; derived adjunction: Tag 0FND, derived.tex, lemma-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general.

proof.text:
Precompose the equation of Step 4 with $\Delta H(\kappa^k_N)$, whose source is $\Delta HG N=\Delta X$. Use the specified identification $\Delta H=H_{\mathrm{tow}}\Delta$, identity on every component, from [def-trf-integral-tower-inverse-image-unit]. Apply the exact derived functor $H_{\mathrm{tow}}$ to the second equation of Step 2. Since functors preserve compositions and inverse morphisms, $H_{\mathrm{tow}}(\Delta[G(q)]^{-1})=\Delta[HG(q)]^{-1}=\Delta[Q]^{-1}$. Consequently
$$\begin{aligned}\epsilon_D\circ\Delta(b)&=u_{h,C_k}\circ H_{\mathrm{tow}}(\epsilon_{C_k}\circ\Delta(\kappa^k_N))\\&=u_{h,C_k}\circ H_{\mathrm{tow}}(\theta_k^\Delta)\circ\Delta[Q]^{-1}.\end{aligned}$$
This is the second asserted identity. Every operation used here is on the whole strict tower; the proof neither compares separate evaluations nor cancels a map out of $R\lim$.
